fields.description: The Propose Only task that parked this row.
fields.label: Task

fields.description: Pending — waiting for a human to approve or discard it. Approved — written to the record type below. Discarded — never written.
fields.label: Status

fields.description: The record type this row would create or change once approved.
fields.label: Record Type

fields.description: The OCR pass's confidence in the file this row was read from, 0 to 1. Empty for a row read from text rather than a file.
fields.label: Confidence

fields.description: What approving this row did — the same record counts an unattended run would have recorded.
fields.label: Outcome

fields.description: The record approving this row created, for the Undo action. Empty for an Approved row that only updated an existing record, and cleared once undone.
fields.label: Created (JSON)

fields.description: Identifies this row so a repeated run finds it instead of filing a duplicate.
fields.label: Fingerprint

fields.description: The extracted row (or file record), unchanged, as the writer would receive it.
fields.label: Payload (JSON)

fields.description: How the payload maps onto the record type — the same shape the writer uses.
fields.label: Mapping (JSON)
